title: Thanksgiving Week Survey Showdown
shortDescription: Thanksgiving Week Survey Showdown at The Mill at Fountain Inn.
description: Bring your team to The Mill at Fountain Inn for Thanksgiving Week Survey Showdown with Four Dogs Entertainment. Try to guess the most popular answers to entertaining survey questions in a lively, hosted team game. It's friendly competition to kick off Thanksgiving week.
instructions: Contact the venue for seating or participation details. Food and drinks are purchased separately.
